entries.wording: 貨件已抵達中工營業所，分貨中。

entries.wording: 貨件由五股營業所人員配送中。

A pickup the sender booked is being arranged. The page lists it after the scans, and it can carry only its day.

entries.note: The driver collected the parcel from the sender; HCT's website labels it 已取件. The branch name changes with the parcel.
A call nobody answered, on a pickup or a delivery round. It does not say where the parcel is, so it has no stage.
A pickup moved to another time. The parcel stays with the sender at the stage it had, so the notice has no stage.
